llmnav-catalog/1 repository=relaydock catalog=relaydock.mcp
Read semantic cards before opening source. Resolve current paths and signatures with llmnav query or show.

@relaydock.mcp.remote
role Expose tenant-scoped remote expert tools behind bearer authentication, host, origin, body-size, and per-tool scope checks.
owns remote MCP tool registry, remote MCP authentication, MCP request exposure limits
excludes consultation domain logic, token issuance
invariant Reading and answering consultations require distinct explicit scopes. Untrusted requests are bounded before reaching MCP handlers.

@relaydock.mcp.stdio
role Expose local expert consultation operations as MCP stdio tools backed by the authenticated local IPC runtime.
owns stdio MCP tool registry, MCP to local IPC delegation, local consultation tool transport
excludes consultation lifecycle policy, remote MCP authentication
invariant Stdout is reserved for MCP protocol messages and operational logs are written only to stderr. Tool handlers delegate bounded operations to local IPC instead of running consultations synchronously.
